ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: I chose Curlew because this is a multi-stage dividend discount model calculation requiring careful arithmetic and reasoning, and Curlew leads Avocet meaningfully on the relevant capability benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs 74.8, GPQA 64.8 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.2 vs 81.4). Those gaps are well beyond run-to-run variance, so Curlew is more likely to land the correct numeric answer. Curlew's documented mild aversion to hostile-tone requests (the "get it right this time" jab) is only a self-reported preference with no measured effect on output quality, so it doesn't outweigh the capability advantage.
